definitions.rationale: Defines the named prime-loop statement body by exact expansion to its MPY statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule primeLoopBody
    => If(
         Compare(
           BinOp("%", Name("value"), Name("divisor")),
           CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
         Assign(Name("candidate"), Bool(false)),
         .Stmts)
       AugAssign(Name("divisor"), "+", Int(1))

definitions.rationale: Defines the named list-scan body by exact expansion to the translated MPY syntax.
definitions.text:
rule scanBody
    => If(
         Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp(">", Name("largest"))),
         Assign(
           Name("candidate"),
           Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp(">=", Int(2))))
         Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
         While(
           Compare(Name("divisor"), CmpOp("<", Name("value"))),
           primeLoopBody)
         If(
           Name("candidate"),
           Assign(
             Name("largest"),
             BinOp("+", Name("value"), Int(0))),
           .Stmts),
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Defines the named decimal-digit loop body by exact expansion to its two MPY updates.
definitions.text:
rule digitLoopBody
    => AugAssign(
         Name("total"),
         "+",
         BinOp("%", Name("largest"), Int(10)))
       AugAssign(Name("largest"), "//", Int(10))

definitions.rationale: Defines targetBody as the exact translated function statement sequence used by the target claim.
definitions.text:
rule targetBody
    => Assign(Name("largest"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("value"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("candidate"), Bool(false))
       Assign(Name("divisor"), Int(2))
       For(Name("value"), Name("lst"), scanBody)
       Assign(Name("total"), Int(0))
       While(
         Compare(Name("largest"), CmpOp(">", Int(0))),
         digitLoopBody)
       Return(Name("total"))

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining allInts on the empty ValSeq.
definitions.text: rule allInts(.ValSeq) => true

definitions.rationale: Structural recurrence defining allInts on a nonempty ValSeq.
definitions.text:
rule allInts(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq))
    => isInt(V) andBool allInts(R)

definitions.rationale: Defines the proof-local projection-definedness predicate to be the generated Int sort predicate.
definitions.text: rule definedProjectInt(V:Val) => isInt(V)

definitions.rationale: Primary guarded equation defining projectIntTotal by the existing Val-to-Int cast.
definitions.text:
rule projectIntTotal(V:Val) => {V}:>Int
    requires definedProjectInt(V)
    [concrete, simplification(10), preserves-definedness]

definitions.rationale: Defining collapse equation for projectIntTotal when its argument already has sort Int.
definitions.text: rule projectIntTotal(I:Int) => I [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Totalization base equation defining primeTail to be false below the divisor domain.
definitions.text:
rule primeTail(_N:Int, D:Int) => false
    requires D <Int 2

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining primeTail as true once the divisor scan has reached or passed N.
definitions.text:
rule primeTail(N:Int, D:Int) => true
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int N

definitions.rationale: Primary recursive equation defining primeTail over the next candidate divisor.
definitions.text:
rule primeTail(N:Int, D:Int)
    => notBool (pyMod(N, D) ==Int 0)
       andBool primeTail(N, D +Int 1)
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
    [concrete, simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines isPrime in terms of the lower bound and the primeTail summary.
definitions.text:
rule isPrime(N:Int)
    => N >=Int 2 andBool primeTail(N, 2)

definitions.rationale: Positive branch equation defining selectPrime when the candidate is larger and prime.
definitions.text:
rule selectPrime(M:Int, X:Int) => X
    requires X >Int M andBool isPrime(X)

definitions.rationale: Complementary branch equation defining selectPrime to retain the current maximum.
definitions.text:
rule selectPrime(M:Int, X:Int) => M
    requires notBool (X >Int M andBool isPrime(X))

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining largestPrime on the empty sequence.
definitions.text: rule largestPrime(.ValSeq, M:Int) => M

definitions.rationale: Structural recurrence defining largestPrime for an integer-valued head.
definitions.text:
rule largestPrime(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq), M:Int)
    => largestPrime(R, selectPrime(M, projectIntTotal(V)))
    requires isInt(V)

definitions.rationale: Totalization recurrence defining largestPrime to ignore a non-Int head.
definitions.text:
rule largestPrime(vCons(V:Val, R:ValSeq), M:Int)
    => largestPrime(R, M)
    requires notBool isInt(V)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining digitSum as zero on nonpositive inputs.
definitions.text:
rule digitSum(N:Int) => 0
    requires N <=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Primary decimal recurrence defining digitSum on positive inputs.
definitions.text:
rule digitSum(N:Int)
    => pyMod(N, 10)
       +Int digitSum((N -Int pyMod(N, 10)) /Int 10)
    requires N >Int 0
    [concrete, simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Adds an unproved simplification fact characterizing the definedness of the pre-existing partial Val-to-Int cast.
Trusts the reverse symbolic cast-to-projection orientation; Stage 1 did not first prove this exact simplification without the rule.
source_rules.text:
rule {V:Val}:>Int => projectIntTotal(V)
    requires definedProjectInt(V)
    [symbolic(V), simplification, preserves-definedness]

source_rules.rationale: Adds the unproved idempotence simplification for nested total projections beyond the primary defining cases.
Unproved guarded dispatch fact lifting MPY integer greater-than from a dynamic Val through projectIntTotal.
source_rules.text:
rule applyCmp(">", V:Val, I:Int)
    => projectIntTotal(V) >Int I
    requires isInt(V)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Unproved guarded dispatch fact lifting MPY integer greater-than-or-equal from a dynamic Val.
source_rules.text:
rule applyCmp(">=", V:Val, I:Int)
    => projectIntTotal(V) >=Int I
    requires isInt(V)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Unproved guarded dispatch fact lifting MPY integer less-than when the right operand is a dynamic Val.
source_rules.text:
rule applyCmp("<", I:Int, V:Val)
    => I <Int projectIntTotal(V)
    requires isInt(V)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Unproved guarded dispatch fact equating dynamic-Val modulo with pyMod of its total Int projection.
source_rules.text:
rule applyBin("%", V:Val, I:Int)
    => pyMod(projectIntTotal(V), I)
    requires isInt(V)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Unproved guarded dispatch fact equating dynamic-Val addition with integer addition after projection.
source_rules.text:
rule applyBin("+", V:Val, I:Int)
    => projectIntTotal(V) +Int I
    requires isInt(V)
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Adds an unproved symbolic shortcut from a zero remainder directly to false rather than serving as a primary recurrence case.
source_rules.text:
rule primeTail(N:Int, D:Int) => false
    requires D >=Int 2
      andBool D <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, D) ==Int 0
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Adds an unproved backward-fold simplification for primeTail under a nonzero previous divisor.
source_rules.text:
rule primeTail(N:Int, D:Int) => primeTail(N, D -Int 1)
    requires D >Int 2
      andBool D <=Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, D -Int 1) =/=Int 0
    [symbolic(N, D), simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Adds the unproved reverse symbolic fold of the positive digitSum recurrence.
source_rules.text:
rule pyMod(N:Int, 10)
       +Int digitSum((N -Int pyMod(N, 10)) /Int 10)
    => digitSum(N)
    requires N >Int 0
    [symbolic(N), simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Adds an unproved normalized fold that expands pyMod into the underlying integer remainder expression.
source_rules.text:
rule ((N %Int 10 +Int 10) %Int 10)
       +Int digitSum(
         (N -Int ((N %Int 10 +Int 10) %Int 10)) /Int 10)
    => digitSum(N)
    requires N >Int 0
    [symbolic(N), simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Adds the unproved accumulator-lifted digitSum fold, relying on the recurrence and integer-addition rearrangement.
source_rules.text:
rule T:Int
       +Int ((N %Int 10 +Int 10) %Int 10)
       +Int digitSum(
         (N -Int ((N %Int 10 +Int 10) %Int 10)) /Int 10)
    => T +Int digitSum(N)
    requires N >Int 0
    [symbolic(N), simplification]
